title: Shipping discount promotion
description: Promote discounted shipping rates to small business senders on WhatsApp with a coupon. Marketing template for couriers. Copy it and adapt the brand.
notes: Lead with a number (percent or amount) and an end date. Offer a coupon code via copy-code button.

body.text: Ship more for less, {{first_name}}! Get *{{discount}} off* all domestic shipments until {{end_date}}. Apply the code at checkout in your dashboard.
